class.name: NetwSchema
class.brief_description: A named list of typed columns.
class.description:
Finish declaring columns before a session uses the [NetwSchema]. Column methods return indices for reading and writing [NetwTable] values. [codeblock] class Mobs: static var schema := Netw.configure_schema(&"Mob") static var pos := schema.vector3( &"pos", NetwQuantizeScalar.new().limits(-512.0, 512.0).step(0.03), ) static var vel := schema.vector3(&"vel") static var hp := schema.u16(&"hp")
@onready var mobs: NetwTable = Netw.session(self).table(Mobs.schema.schema_name) [/codeblock] [NetwDatabase] stores records directly. [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] defines a [NetwEntity]'s saved properties.

method.name: boolean
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_BOOL] column, one bit per element on the wire.

method.name: color
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_COLOR] column.

method.name: column
method.description: Declaring [param key] again with the same [param type] and [param stride] returns its existing index. A different shape returns [code]-1[/code] and appends nothing.

method.name: create
method.description: Builds a schema under [param name] without adding it to the schema registry. Use [method Netw.configure_schema] to get the registered one, or call [method register] later.

method.name: declare
method.description: Calls with the same [param name] share one [NetwSchema]. Empty names are refused.

method.name: entity
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_ENTITY] column of routes, pointing at rows of another table.

method.name: f32
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_F32] column.

method.name: f64
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_F64] column.

method.name: i8
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I8] column.

method.name: i16
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I16] column.

method.name: i32
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I32] column.

method.name: i64
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I64] column.

method.name: is_reliable
method.description: Whether this [NetwSchema]'s [NetwTable] sends commits reliably. Set by [method reliable].

method.name: is_replicated
method.description: Whether a session creates a replicated [NetwTable] from this [NetwSchema]. Set by [method replicated].

method.name: migrate
method.description:
A read runs one [param step] per saved version up to [method storage_version]. A missing step refuses the read. [codeblock lang=text] step(values: Dictionary) -> Dictionary
Dictionary ┖╴saved column name Variant the value stored under that name [/codeblock] [codeblock] static var schema := NetwSchema.create(&"players") \ .replicated(false) \ .storage_version(2) \ .migrate(1, PlayerSave.add_position)
static func add_position(row: Dictionary) -> Dictionary: row[&"position"] = Vector2.ZERO return row [/codeblock] The stored record is not rewritten by the read. The next save writes it at the current version.

method.name: quaternion
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_QUATERNION] column, stored as a [PackedVector4Array] and read as [Quaternion] so [NetwQuantizeQuaternion] can compress it.

method.name: register
method.description: Registers this [NetwSchema] if no [NetwSchema] with the same [member schema_name] is registered.

method.name: reliable
method.description: Use for a [NetwTable] whose next commit cannot repair a lost update.

method.name: replicated
method.description: Pass [code]false[/code] for a [NetwSchema] used only by [NetwDatabase].

method.name: storage_version
method.description: Raise it when the saved columns change, and add a [method migrate] step from the previous version. It does not affect replication, so peers on different storage versions still connect.

method.name: string
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_STRING] column. Like [method variant], a schema holding one cannot become a replicated table.

method.name: u8
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_U8] column.

method.name: u16
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_U16] column.

method.name: variant
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VARIANT] column, for a [Dictionary], an [Array] or any other value. A schema holding one cannot become a replicated table. A saved value holds data only. An [Object], [Resource], [Callable], [Signal] or [RID] is refused, including one nested inside an [Array] or a [Dictionary].

method.name: vector2
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR2] column.

method.name: vector3
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR3] column.

method.name: vector4
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR4] column.
